name: Enjel Clement
source:
In contrast to his elder brother, Enjel is known to be shy, closed off, but kind and gentle once you're on friendly terms with him. At first glance, one might think that he's a weak doormat. However, few claim that he can be assertive in some cases. Just like Evan, he's also rather secretive, never fully opening up to others about himself.

[From [url=https://syllphana.itch.io/rotten-angel]itch.io[/url]]
